question: How can parents teach chess to children?
direct_answer_draft (40-60 words; owner/: Start with how the pieces move, one piece at a time, using mini-games (pawn wars, capture the queen) before full games. Keep sessions to 15–20 minutes for young children, praise good thinking rather than wins, and play often. A coach helps once your child knows the rules and needs tactics and structure.

question: What should a beginner learn first in chess?
direct_answer_draft (40-60 words; owner/: First learn how each piece moves and captures, then check and checkmate, then the basic checkmates (king and queen, king and rook). After that, learn the opening principles: control the centre, develop knights and bishops, castle early. Only then move on to tactics like forks and pins.
